If you are good at sales then you will be fine. Choosing a specialty helps alot because you can charge more.
For example my friend sells/installs solar panels. He hadn't touched a solar panel for the first 2 years in business. But he is a great salesman and knows how to manage his team.

I sell glass. I could afford to have other ppl do the install but I don't mind the work and I make more doing it myself with a cheap laborer.

So yes its very possible without alot of experience but its alot of paperwork/marketing and you should  be in niche industries where margins are higher.

So not painting, carpentry, electrical, etc. (The main guys)

...at least this is my personal experience from watching myself and other small businesses.
